connector.name: Distribea MCP
connector.registryDescription: Generate images, video, music and voice from your CLI or AI agent. On-brand AI media toolkit.
connector.summary: Hosted at distribea.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package distribea-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the distribea account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — your Distribea MCP access key (dmcp_…) from https://distribea.com/account/mcp. Used by hosted site builders (Lovable, Bolt, v0…) that call the engine over HTTP.

env.name: DISTRIBEA_MCP_KEY
env.description: Your Distribea MCP access key (dmcp_…). Get it from your account page at https://distribea.com/account/mcp.
